nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## Portraius Studio on your GPU: a character from photos

The turnaround sheet from your photos, then the front, three-quarter, profile and full-body views from the photos and that sheet, the way Cast and elements makes a character on your GPU. Qwen takes three images, so the sheet gets three photos and each view the first two plus the sheet. Put three photos of yourself in `ComfyUI/input/` as `my-photo-1.jpg`, `my-photo-2.jpg`, `my-photo-3.jpg`: varied angles, good light, one face each.

The app also checks consent on camera first, and scores each view against your photos. The graph does neither.

**Inputs in `ComfyUI/input/`:** `my-photo-1.jpg`, `my-photo-2.jpg`, `my-photo-3.jpg`. Samples are in this repo's `public/samples/`.

Free: open-weight models and ComfyUI's own nodes, so no account or credits. Built by the app's own local adapters from the request its studio makes, so it matches what "On your GPU" sends (docs/local-setup.md).

**Models (Qwen-Image-Edit 2511).** Every file is Apache 2.0.

| Folder in `ComfyUI/models/` | File | GB |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `diffusion_models` | [qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-Edit_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors) | 20.5 |
| `text_encoders` | [qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors) | 9.4 |
| `vae` | [qwen_image_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors) | 0.3 |
| `loras` | [Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning-8steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning/resolve/main/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning-8steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors) | 0.9 |

nodes.title: Text Encode Qwen Image Edit Plus
widgets_values:
Create a character reference sheet of the same person shown in the attached photos.
Keep their exact facial structure, skin tone and texture, hairline, hair, eye shape, and any
marks or features. Do not beautify, slim, smooth the skin or change their age.
Layout: one 16:9 image, plain mid-grey studio background, soft even front lighting, natural
skin texture with visible pores.
Panels left to right: front head-and-shoulders, three-quarter left, left profile, full body
standing front-facing in simple neutral clothing, and a strip of four expressions (neutral,
smile, surprised, serious).
No text, labels, borders or watermarks.
